items.name: Whimsy
items.mechanic: Passive: after losing health, relocate to a random legal hex.
relatedUpgradeContexts: Whimsy (Fae, tier 3): Whenever a Fae unit loses health, it is relocated to a random hex.

items.name: Diggy Hole
items.mechanic: Dwarven units do not spawn at battle start. After 10 beats, they spawn on the enemy side of the board with 100 readiness, and each emerging Dwarf makes all enemies lose 1 rate.

items.name: Ale and Hearty
items.mechanic: Dwarven troops gain +60% rate. One random unit from each Dwarven troop has its rate set to 1 at the start of combat.

items.name: Stall Warts
items.mechanic: Dwarven troops gain +1 armor and lose 1 rate for the rest of the battle after they are hit by normal attacks.

items.name: Feline Grace
items.mechanic: All non-melee elven troops gain +2 range. The first time each battle an engaged elven backline unit retreats 1 hex for free.

items.name: Silvershot Doctrine
items.mechanic: Elven ranged and caster attacks gain +1 damage and +2 readiness per hex of distance to the target. Attacks made from max range make the target lose 30 readiness.

items.name: Forsaken
items.mechanic: Start of battle: if an elven unit is the only troop on its side, it gains +80% health, +80% damage, and +80% rate.

items.name: Glamour
items.mechanic: Once per battle per Fae unit, redirect an incoming normal attack to a random enemy in range as if the Fae unit made that attack.

items.name: Changeling
items.mechanic: If a Fae troop was brought to battle, after beat 12 a random enemy unit from each enemy troop changes sides.

items.name: Whimsy
items.mechanic: Whenever a Fae unit loses health, it is relocated to a random hex.

items.name: Gallowsworn
items.mechanic: On death: each goblin unit makes 1 extra strike against a random enemy touching it. When a goblin gets a kill, all enemies lose 10 readiness.

items.name: Overwhelm Hex
items.mechanic: When a Goblin is present, a random unit from each enemy troop gains 1 stack of Hex at the start of the battle. Enemies lose health equal to the number of your living Goblins per stack of Hex they have at the end of their turn.

items.name: Horde
items.mechanic: Start of turn: each goblin unit gains +4 damage per other friendly unit touching it until end of turn.

items.name: Tubthumping
items.mechanic: Overworld: human troops may enter the same Rift together. Effects that would reduce a Human unit rate or damage instead increase it by 1.

items.name: Combined Arms
items.mechanic: Start of battle: each human unit gains +20% health, +20% damage, and +20% rate for each other friendly troop on its side.

items.name: Hold the Standard
items.mechanic: Whenever a non-Fading ally dies, each Human unit restores 15 health.

items.name: Seeing Red
items.mechanic: Whenever an Orc unit kills an enemy unit, it loses 1 armor for the battle and gains 75 readiness.

items.name: First Blood
items.mechanic: Orc units attack their target whenever they engage, in addition to the normal engagement attack.

items.name: Berserk
items.mechanic: When an Orc unit would die from health loss, its readiness is set to 0, it stops losing health, and it dies at the end of its next turn.

items.name: Gargantuan Zeal
items.mechanic: When a Troll is present, a random unit from each allied troop gains 1 stack of Zeal at the start of the battle. Allies gain damage based on their bulk for each stack of Zeal they have.

items.name: Mossblood
items.mechanic: After losing health, each troll unit gains +1 damage for the rest of the battle. The first time each troll would die in a battle, it survives at 25 HP and loses Regen for the rest of that battle.

items.name: Rowdy Regrowth
items.mechanic: Whenever a Troll regains health, it gains 20 readiness and +1 damage.

items.name: Corrosion
items.mechanic: All units start with 0 armor and cannot have positive armor.
items.target: all units or the whole battle

items.name: Decay
items.mechanic: Every beat, each unit loses 1 HP ignoring armor.
items.target: all units or the whole battle

items.name: Haze
items.mechanic: All units lose 5 rate.
items.target: all units or the whole battle

items.name: Heavy Air
items.mechanic: Ranged attacks deal 50% less damage.
items.target: all units or the whole battle

items.name: Momentum
items.mechanic: All units gain +10 readiness every beat.
items.target: all units or the whole battle

items.name: Quakes
items.mechanic: Every 10 beats, each unit is moved to a random adjacent hex if one fits.
items.target: all units or the whole battle

items.name: Barrage
items.mechanic: Archers shoot all enemies within their attack range when they aren't engaged in melee, but their attacks deal 40% less damage.

items.name: Crippling Shots
items.mechanic: On attack: each Archer reduces its target armor by 1 and rate by 1 for the rest of the battle.

items.name: Hexing Shots
items.mechanic: Archer attacks deal +1 damage per Hex stack on the target.

items.name: Sevenfold
items.mechanic: Whenever a nearby unit leaves a corpse, each Avenger may consume it to summon a skeleton there, up to 7 times per battle.
items.trigger: onFallen; max 7 uses; near fallen all unit

items.name: Wages of Virtue
items.mechanic: Avengers redirect incoming normal attacks to a random adjacent ally if possible. Whenever an ally adjacent to an Avenger regains health, that Avenger regains the same amount.

items.name: Witness
items.mechanic: When a nearby ally falls, set this Avenger readiness to 100. When a touching ally dies, it strikes the killer if still in contact.

items.name: Opening
items.mechanic: When a Beastmaster hits an enemy, all allies adjacent to the target also attack that enemy.

items.name: Thrill of the Hunt
items.mechanic: Wolves summon 1 Wolf on each kill. Whenever any wolf gets a kill, all allies gain +1 damage for the battle.

items.name: Throwing Axes
items.mechanic: Beastmasters gain 4 range. Their attacks deal additional damage equal to 10% of the enemy's current health.

items.name: Anointed Executioner
items.mechanic: Champions target the lowest-health enemy they are allowed to attack. Whenever a Champion regains health or gains positive stats, it gains twice as much.

items.name: Honorable Duel
items.mechanic: Champions cannot be targeted with normal attacks by enemies they aren't engaged with.

items.name: Triumphant Zeal
items.mechanic: On kill, Champions and touching allies gain a stack of Zeal. Allies gain +10% damage, +10% rate, and +10% max health for each stack of Zeal they have.

items.name: True Form
items.mechanic: Druid's Shapeshift can now trigger an additional time.
items.trigger: endOfTurn; charge every 5 turns; max 2 uses

items.name: Ent's Visage
items.mechanic: After shapeshifting, attackers lose 6 health whenever they hit the Druid with a normal attack. Each time a Druid shapeshifts, its melee attacks gain an additional battle-long -2 rate debuff on hit.

items.name: Forest Friends
items.mechanic: End of turn: each Druid restores 20 health to itself and all units Bonded to that specific Druid. Whenever a Druid shapeshifts, it summons 2 wolves.

items.name: Crack Exploits
items.mechanic: Elementalists lose 5 damage. Whenever an enemy loses armor, each Elementalist makes a normal attack against them ignoring range. Allied elementals remove 1 armor on attack.

items.name: Crackling Mitosis
items.mechanic: When an allied elemental dies, enemies within 2 hexes of its occupied hexes lose 8 health. Elementals summoned by Elementalists can repeat that summon once after 4 turns.

items.name: Living Circuit
items.mechanic: End of turn: if any allied elemental is in range, this Elementalist gains 15 readiness once and all allied elementals in range gain 15 readiness.

items.name: Dine in Hell
items.mechanic: Start of turn: if a Knight is engaged at full capacity, it gains +10 armor until next turn. Whenever a Knight is hit by a normal attack while engaged at full capacity, it makes 1 normal attack back.

items.name: Sentinel Runes
items.mechanic: The first time an enemy moves out of contact with a Knight, summon 2 elementals at that unit's new position; they immediately engage and attack that unit. If unused, this also triggers on death against the killer.

items.name: Sunder
items.mechanic: Knights remove 20 armor on attack.

items.name: Crippling Hex
items.mechanic: Enemies who kill Militia gain 1 stack of Hex. Enemies get -30% rate for each stack of Hex.

items.name: Dogpile
items.mechanic: When Militia attack an enemy engaged by at least 3 allies, they strike 1 extra time.

items.name: R-selected
items.mechanic: Start of turn: Militia gain +10 readiness for each other Militia touching them. Overworld: multiple Militia troops may enter the same Rift together.

items.name: Explosion Corpse
items.mechanic: Skeletons summoned by Necromancers spawn with +100 readiness. Whenever this Necromancer consumes a corpse, enemies adjacent to that corpse lose 1 armor and 1 damage for the battle.

items.name: Hemomancy
items.mechanic: Necromancers may spend 10 health instead of requiring or consuming a corpse for corpse-consuming abilities, as long as that would not kill them. Allied summoned Skeletons restore 7 health to allies on their own hex at the end of each turn.

items.name: Saintbane
items.mechanic: Whenever an enemy gains stats or regains health, all corpses adjacent to them are raised as Skeletons as though an allied Necromancer had summoned them.

items.name: Bolstering Light
items.mechanic: When Priest health restoration brings its target to full HP, that target and the Priest gain +1 rate and +1 damage for the battle. Otherwise, that target and the Priest gain 40 readiness.

items.name: Holy Constructs
items.mechanic: While a Priest is present in a battle: the first time each non-Fading ally regains health, an Elemental is summoned adjacent to them. Elementals now restore 20 health to adjacent allies on death.

items.name: Mercy Before Dawn
items.mechanic: The first time each battle each allied unit within this Priest's range would die, it survives at 1 HP. Whenever a Priest restores health to an ally, that healing repeats on all allies in range under 10% health.

items.name: Hunter's Zeal
items.mechanic: On kill, Rangers and allies adjacent to the killed enemy gain a stack of Zeal. Allies gain 5 readiness for each stack of Zeal they have at the end of their turns.

items.name: On the Hunt
items.mechanic: On attack: each Ranger sets its target readiness to 0. The first 2 times a Ranger kills a non-Fading enemy, consume the corpse and summon 1 wolf there.

items.name: Shadow's Embrace
items.mechanic: After attacking, Rangers move to the safest hex that still keeps an enemy in range. Ranger attacks against unengaged targets deal double damage.

items.name: War Drums
items.mechanic: Enhance 1 affects all allies on the chosen ally hex instead of one random ally.

items.name: Final Hex
items.mechanic: Shamans apply 1 stack of Hexed to enemies they attack. When attacking an enemy with 5 stacks of Hexed, Shamans kill that enemy.

items.name: Grave Vigor
items.mechanic: Whenever a Shaman applies a beneficial effect, that target leaves no corpse on death and summons 1 skeleton on death, gains 1 extra strike on its next normal attack if the effect was Enhance, and then ignores future beneficial effects and targeting from units with Grave Vigor.

items.name: Dreamwork
items.mechanic: Whenever an enemy adjacent to a Soldier is hit by another ally's normal attack, that Soldier makes a normal attack against it. Each Soldier can trigger at most once per beat.

items.name: Martyr's Zeal
items.mechanic: When a Soldier dies, all allies gain a stack of Zeal. Allies restore 5 health for each stack of Zeal they have at the end of their turns.

items.name: Shield Drill
items.mechanic: Soldiers have -4 armor, but each ranged attack can make a Soldier lose at most 1 health after all modifiers.

items.name: Spell Echo
items.mechanic: Each time this Wizard's Blast hits enemies, repeat that Blast from every enemy hit by that Blast or its echoes, but no enemy can be hit more than once per Blast chain.

items.name: Storm Rods
items.mechanic: Every 4 turns, each Wizard makes 2 extra strikes against a random enemy within its range. Wizard Blasts deal +1 damage per allied elemental on the battlefield, and Wizards summon 1 elemental at the start of battle.

items.name: Vulnerability Hex
items.mechanic: If a Wizard is present in a battle, enemies hit by Blast have a 20% chance of gaining a stack of Hex. Each enemy loses 100% more health from Blast for each stack of Hex they have.
